messages:
anya: Heads-up: saw a cluster of provisional charges during the canary. Pattern: streaming session gets truncated by tool, client reconnects, new session gets credited for overlapping chunks.
sam: Can you dump a short log snippet?
kevin: sure, router trace (redacted):
```
[2024-03-15T18:12:01Z] session=zz9 route=canary cb=tripped
[2024-03-15T18:12:01Z] session=zz9 toolcall=audio status=truncation chunk=2/6
[2024-03-15T18:12:02Z] client retry new_session=zz9b orig_session=zz9
[2024-03-15T18:12:02Z] billing provisional session=zz9 tokens=110 chunks=[1,2]
[2024-03-15T18:12:03Z] billing provisional session=zz9b tokens=120 chunks=[2,3]
```
izzy: Root cause seems provenance: router creates new session ids on handoff and we key provisional ledger by session. No cross-session dedupe.
anya: Short-term fix options: A) preserve request-id across reconnects B) router attach X-Session-Origin header so reconciler can link C) reconciler fingerprint chunks and merge duplicates.
kevin: B feels low-risk: add header X-Session-Origin=<orig_session> on reconnects behind feature flag. Reconciler can then dedupe based on origin link.
sam: But reconciler merging must be conservative: only dedupe when time_delta < 2m OR tool marks truncation. Otherwise we risk collapsing legitimate retries.
izzy: Also add chunk-level fingerprinting as fallback: sha256(normalize(prompt)+model+chunk_index). Reconciler can use fingerprint when origin header missing.
billing-bot: For merges we need merge_id and reason. API: POST /internal/billing/resolve_merge {merge_id, sessions, merged_tokens, reason}. Finance requests throttling on auto-refunds during rollout.
deploy-bot: Feature flag rollout plan suggested: attach_session_origin -> canary -> 5% -> 50% -> 100% over 24h. Reconciler.chunk_merge_v1 behind separate flag; read-only mode first.
anya: Telemetry: router.session_origin_sent, reconciler.merge_attempts, reconciler.merge_reject_reasons, billing.auto_refund_rate. Console: show "merged provisional" as collapsed group with link to trace and an annotation explaining reason.
kevin: I'll prototype router header + reconciler merge_id. Tests: unit for fingerprint, integration sim of truncation+reconnect, e2e verifying console shows merged group. ETA: PRs open tomorrow.
sam: Also add a metric for "reconciler.refused_merge_no_origin" so we know how much impact header will have.
anya: Good. If rollout shows high refund churn we throttle and revert header. I'll draft ops runbook steps for manual reversal.
izzy: I'll ping tool-team about emitting explicit X-Tool-Truncated for partial responses; that makes heuristics safer.
anya: Thanks all. I'll monitor merged_provisional_count in canary and pull finance in if refund volume spikes.
sam: Nice work :thumbsup:
